statements.t: "Our third quarter operating performance was consistent with our expectations, and, while challenging consumer conditions have led to more muted volumes than we initially anticipated during the quarter, our operating performance and strong focus on costs delivered earnings at the high end of our estimated range.

As we came into the year, our plan was to deliver adjusted EPS growth irrespective of end market demand growth, and we are on track to deliver adjusted EPS at the higher end of our initial guidance for 2026.

We remain confident in our ability to expand our high value, higher growth dispensing business both organically and through continued returns-based investments, and our food and beverage focused businesses continue to display remarkable resilience and excellent free cash flow generation.
